runner_hardening.accepted_parent_policy: P4.5 is no longer re-executed inside the P4.6 gate; the runner verifies accepted validation status, accepted aggregate and exact accepted P4.5 kernel/test/runner/validation blobs
runner_hardening.reason: the prior direct P4.5 regression is already represented by durable exact Windows acceptance evidence and created a long silent phase before P4.6 itself began
runner_hardening.timeout_behavior: fail closed and terminate the Godot process tree
runner_hardening.output_behavior: stdout/stderr remain asynchronously drained to avoid pipe deadlock; elapsed-time heartbeat is printed while each process runs

contract.server_read_projection: P4.6 derives bounded client summaries only from a validated P4.5 ownership state; canonical ecology remains server-owned
contract.summary_identity: summary_hash binds region, owner/epoch source cursor, source snapshot/ownership hashes, ecology generation/time cursor, backlog state and canonical lineage biomass summary
contract.interest: requested region ids are canonicalized as sorted unique ids; duplicate authoritative states fail closed; missing requested regions remain explicit
contract.read_cache: client read updates are monotonic by ownership epoch, ecology generation and observed horizon; stale epochs/generations/times and equal-cursor conflicts fail closed
contract.mutation_isolation: returned summaries/projections are detached values; no API commits client data into P4.5 ownership

real_committed_integration_gate.purpose: close the remaining synthetic-unit gap with a real accepted P3/P4.1-P4.5 state
real_committed_integration_gate.fixture: reconstructs the same accepted P4.5 ecology fixture without modifying any accepted test or kernel
real_committed_integration_gate.runner_policy: verify accepted P4.5 lifecycle identity without re-execution; run P4.6 unit A/B with frozen hashes; run real integration A/B with byte-identical logs and discover 64-hex integration identities
